# NainDrive

> Driving school management and deterministic billing platform: students, DGT exams, fleet and invoices with IVA, with a public demo client.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://drive.naindev.com/): the interactive client
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/NainDrive): repository, architecture notes and documentation
- [Author site](https://www.naindev.com/): Aitor Nain Mendoza Vallejo (NainDev)
